entries.headline_claim: Only 1 LAC country (Dominican Republic) has revealed comparative advantage in pharma exports; the largest markets are net importers with low export competitiveness
entries.method: archetype rules over import scale, RCA(HS30) and exp/imp ratio across the LAC-33

entries.headline_claim: 'Full regional integration' avoids the most % extra-regional vs 'Status quo' by 2035
~91% of LAC finished-medicine imports are extra-regional (all-partner, volume-weighted, 10 markets)

entries.headline_claim: extra-regional imports are ~91% by value but only ~53% by mass — dependence is concentrated in high-value drugs
